verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents Resolve, an AI agent on its root-cause-analysis docs page, that takes a production error and opens a tested-fix pull request for review. This goes beyond proposing a root cause to producing an actionable fix, and Rollbar also says the platform points to the code behind each error. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the AI uses breadcrumbs/telemetry and related commits as inputs, a documented human-readable root-cause explanation separate from the PR, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
